finding: The direct strictly-negative all-eight-coordinate five-node certificate is impossible throughout an explicit nonvacuous 11-parameter neighborhood: independently perturb odd-band roots (1,4,7,13,20,24) and squared frequencies (2,3,5,6,8) by at most 10^-40, with the final node inside the second odd band. This holds for every all-Hurwitz independent septic box with those odd intervals, arbitrary even boxes, actual members and positive weights, including additional zero-odd/zero/infinity atoms. Its nonnegative-coefficient test numerator F=(-t)(((t3+t4)/2)-t)(d-t) has positive pairing on all eight positive odd-moment-cone extreme rays. Each ray has two possible worst middle odd endpoints, giving 16 exact mixed-envelope dual identities. All 224 dual multipliers are strictly positive; explicit rational product bounds preserve them throughout the neighborhood. The previously pinned seven-width stable construction proves nonvacuity. This is a direct strict-coordinate result, not just a weak odd-canceling theorem, but it does not settle the remaining five-node parameter space or unrestricted SPR7.
